title: One-Pan Turkey Taco Rice
description: Ground turkey, rice, tomatoes, and corn cooked together in one skillet.

steps.text: Brown 1 pound ground turkey in a deep skillet over medium heat, breaking it into crumbles.
Stir in 2 tablespoons taco seasoning, 1 cup rice, 1 can diced tomatoes, 1 1/2 cups broth, and 1 cup corn.
Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 18 minutes.
Turn off heat and let stand covered 5 minutes, then fluff and serve.

title: Crockpot White Chicken Chili
description: Mild creamy white chili with chicken, beans, corn, and green chiles.

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs

steps.text: Put 1 1/2 pounds chicken, 2 cans white beans, 1 can corn, 1 can green chiles, 3 cups broth, and 1 teaspoon cumin in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on LOW for about 6 hours, until the chicken shreds easily.
Shred the chicken directly in the cooker with two forks.
Stir in 4 ounces cream cheese until melted and creamy.

title: Sheet-Pan Honey Mustard Chicken & Broccoli
description: Chicken and broccoli roast together with a simple sweet-tangy glaze.

ingredients.item: boneless chicken thighs, cut into pieces

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan.
Whisk 2 tablespoons mustard, 1 1/2 tablespoons honey, 1 tablespoon olive oil, and 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder.
Toss 1 1/4 pounds chicken with the glaze on one side of the pan; toss 5 cups broccoli with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil on the other side.
Roast 20–25 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and broccoli is browned at the edges.

title: Easy Shepherd’s Pie Skillet
description: Savory ground beef and vegetables topped with quick mashed potatoes.

steps.text: Heat oven broiler. Brown 1 pound ground beef in an oven-safe skillet and drain excess fat.
Stir in 2 cups frozen mixed vegetables, 1 cup beef broth, and 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce; simmer 8 minutes.
Spread 2 cups prepared mashed potatoes over the beef mixture.
Broil 3–5 minutes until the potato top gets lightly golden.
